body: One 500 ml jar of the Northern Soul gel. One jar of Mag Flux, one of Test Drive and one of Mycrodose, 50 capsules in each. One bottle of Omega DHA Oil. One copy of the book, which the listing describes as the guide to fitting the six together.
The six cards below go to each item's own sheet, where the ingredient lists and the gaps in them are set out.

acc.summary: The schedule as printed on the listing
body: Morning: one tablespoon of the sea moss gel on an empty stomach, then one tablespoon of the Omega DHA Oil and one or two Test Drive capsules, which the listing says to adjust for the intensity of the training. Afternoon: one or two Mag Flux capsules with at least 500 ml of water and a meal. Evening: two Mycrodose capsules with at least 500 ml of water and a meal.
That is the listing's own wording. Two of the jars print different servings on their own sheets, and both differences are on the specification sheet below.
Mag Flux and Test Drive are both printed as proprietary blends. Test Drive names some of its plants and Mag Flux names none, so for either jar there is no full list of what is in a capsule.

If you are tested, that matters more than any figure on this page. Nobody at this shop can hand you a complete ingredient list for those two, so ask your governing body or your doctor before you take them, not after.
Not for children. Not in pregnancy or while breastfeeding. The Test Drive listing states that jar is for men only; it gives no reason, and we are not going to invent one.

If you take nitrates, blood pressure medicine, heart medicine, an anticoagulant, insulin or anything else for blood sugar, or any other prescribed medicine, speak to your GP or pharmacist before you start. There are four mushrooms in the evening jar, so anyone who reacts to mushrooms should leave it alone, and pine pollen in Test Drive is a pollen. Anyone with an overactive thyroid should leave the sea moss alone.

Sent out from 599 Smithdown Road, Liverpool, Tuesday to Sunday. A box with a gel in it goes out chilled. UK delivery is free over £50, or you can collect from the shop between 10 and 6, any day except Monday.

spec.label: Kits · 06
spec.intro: Six items, one printed schedule, and the rows where the box and the jars in it do not say the same thing.
spec.caption: Athletes Kit
rows: Contents
One 500 ml jar of the Northern Soul gel. One jar each of Mag Flux, Test Drive and Mycrodose, 50 capsules in each. One bottle of Omega DHA Oil. One copy of the book.
Price
£199.99. One size. The variant line also reads 2000 g without saying whether that is the box as it ships or what is inside it, so it is not a pack size.
Sold separately
£217.96 at the prices on this site: £50.00 for the 500 ml Northern Soul, plus £39.99, £39.99, £19.99, £39.99 and £28.00. The box is £17.97 under that.
Serving

As printed on this listing. Morning: one tablespoon of gel on an empty stomach, one tablespoon of Omega DHA Oil, one or two Test Drive capsules, adjusted for the intensity of the training. Afternoon: one or two Mag Flux capsules with a meal. Evening: two Mycrodose capsules with a meal. At least 500 ml of water with the capsules.
Test Drive, twice

This listing prints one or two capsules in the morning. The Test Drive listing prints two capsules with breakfast and at least 1 litre of water across the day. Both are ours and they do not agree. Neither is chosen here.
Mag Flux, twice

This listing prints one or two capsules in the afternoon. The Mag Flux listing prints two, with lunch or an afternoon meal. A jar of 50 is 25 days at two and 50 days at one, so the difference is a month.
Course length

Not printed for the box. The six do not run out together: about 33 tablespoons in the gel jar, 25 days in the Mycrodose jar at two a day, 25 to 50 days in each of the other two, and one month a bottle for the oil as its own listing prints it.
Full ingredient lists

Two of the five jars do not have one. Mag Flux is printed as a proprietary blend and Test Drive names some of its plants and not the rest. If you are tested in your sport, that is the row that matters here.
Storage
Gel: refrigerate, use within 28 days of opening or freeze, clean dry spoon. Capsules and the bottle: closed, cool and dry, no fridge.
Suitable for
Adults. No vegan mark on this box, because the Omega DHA Oil listing does not state the source of the oil. The gel and all three capsule jars carry one on their own sheets.
Not printed
No volume for the oil bottle. No full ingredient list for Mag Flux. No milligram split for the plants named in Test Drive. No course length for the box.
Not for

Children. Anyone who is pregnant or breastfeeding. Anyone with an overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism), because of the seaweed. Anyone who reacts to mushrooms: there are four in the evening jar. The Test Drive listing states that jar is for men only and gives no reason for it. If you take nitrates, blood pressure medicine, heart medicine, an anticoagulant, insulin or anything else for blood sugar, or any other prescribed medicine, speak to your GP or pharmacist before you start.
spec.smallprint: Contains iodine from seaweed. Contains mushroom, which is an allergen for some people. Do not exceed the stated dose. Speak to your GP or pharmacist before starting any supplement, particularly if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or take medication. Food supplements should not be used as a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of reach of young children.

doctrine.h3: We publish the specification. We do not publish claims about what it does.
doctrine.p: The sheet above is six items, one schedule, one price and four rows about figures nobody has printed. Athletes Kit is the name on the box. It is a name, not a description, and we do not expand it or say what the box is for. What any of these six items does in a body, in training or anywhere else, is not something we are permitted to tell you, so it is not on this page.

reiss.label: Reiss's turn
reiss.h2: The row I would read before the price
paras: If you are tested in your sport, the important row on that sheet is the one about ingredient lists. Mag Flux prints a proprietary blend and names nothing. Test Drive names some plants and leaves the rest unlisted. I cannot hand you a complete list for either jar, and no bundle price changes that. Ask your governing body first, and if the answer is no, buy neither.

The second thing is that one of the six jars states on its own listing that it is for men only. It gives no reason, we did not write one, and I am not going to pretend it is not there because this box is sold as a set. It is in the last row of the sheet for that reason.

There is no sold separately total on this page because the gel comes in two jars at two prices, and there are two rows where this box prints a different serving from the jar it contains. That is six items and four places where our own paperwork does not line up. I would rather you saw all four than a saving figure.
reiss.pull: I cannot hand you a complete ingredient list for two of these jars, and no bundle price changes that.
